text:
Maria: Hey team — Mosaic (customer) confirmed a 30-min interview next Thu 10am PST. We want a short written quote + 2-3 screenshots for the launch post and a 20-min webinar slot the following week. Who can own the quote + legal review flow?
Casey: I can take lead on quote collection and run the approvals queue. Can someone drop the suggested quote language? :+1:
Sam: I can handle screenshots and a quick promo asset. Need a timestamped recording to pull stills — do we have permission for recording?
Lila (CS): Mosaic okayed recording but wants a short pre-approved quote. Emily (Legal) needs to sign off on wording.
Emily: Loop me in early. Ask for a single-sentence customer quote and a 1-paragraph use case blurb. If they provide multiple options, we prefer shorter. I need the quote 48h before publish for legal clearance.
Josh: For webinar lane: prefer Tues 11am PT (less conflict). Who will moderate? I can do intro + GTM ask.
Maria: Thanks. Plan: Casey collects quote by Mon EOD, Emily signs off by Wed, Sam delivers screenshots + hero image by Thu, webinar on Tue (next week) 11am PT. Recording permission confirmed by Lila.
Casey: Drafting outreach to Mosaic now. Suggested ask in the message: 
```
Hi <Name>, thanks again for agreeing to chat. Would you be comfortable sharing a one-sentence quote (~20 words) for our post and a short paragraph describing the problem you solved and the outcome? We plan to publish the post on [DATE] with a webinar on [WEBINAR_DATE]. We'll send the final quote for approval before publishing.
```
Casey: tagging @Emily when I get their reply.
Emily: Looks good. Two redlines to watch out for: (1) no forward-looking financial claims; (2) no quoting comparative statements about competitors. I'll add a short approval checklist: 
- Confirm permission to record and use screenshots
- Final quote text provided by customer
- Legal clearance checkbox
- Embargo date agreed
Please attach the quote as plain text in Slack for sign-off.
Sam: For assets — what's the preferred size? I can output: hero (1200x628), thumbnail (800x450), and social crop (1080x1080). Also will make slides for the webinar.
Maria: Nice. Use the Redwood brand template in Figma: /projects/redwood-marketing/mosaic-launch (Sam, ping me if you can't access).
Lila (CS): I'll prep the intro call and make sure the customer has the quote prompt. I'll ask them to confirm an embargo date.
Josh: I'll set up the webinar in Zoom and draft the registration page. Need the hero image + short blurb by Fri.
Casey: Received first draft from Mosaic (paste below). Pls review quickly: 
"Mosaic helped us reduce inference costs by 38% while maintaining latency for critical paths. The Redwood platform made deployment predictable and saved engineering time."
Emily: Quick feedback: change "reduce inference costs by 38%" -> "reduce per-token inference cost by ~38%" and remove "saved engineering time" (too vague). Ask them to confirm the metric source (internal benchmark).
Casey: Sent back edited ask and requested metric citation.
Sam: I'll reserve a screenshot slot in the recording and capture the dashboard flow. Also will stage a non-prod key for visuals.
Maria: Timeline check — if Legal signs off Wed, we should lock the blog draft Thu and schedule publish + webinar promo. I'll assemble the post draft in Google Docs and share.
deploy-bot: Reminder set: webinar setup due in 3 days (2191237890).
Josh: Thanks bot. Also adding promo cadence: announce webinar 5 days before, reminder 1 day before, final reminder 1 hour before.
Emily: Once final quote is in Slack, I'll post approval emoji (:white_check_mark:). If anything needs redline, I'll include a one-line note.
Casey: Got it. Will update thread with final quote and the customer's short permission line.
Lila (CS): Customer tentatively agreed to embargo until publish date. Will confirm final time tomorrow.
Maria: Great work everyone. If you hit blockers ping me or drop here. :rocket:
